description:
Agents grep and sed the raw config file for type hierarchy, development root, archive root, and managed paths (~10 mined occurrences, including hand-rolled awk in skill scripts) because config introspection covers only part of the surface.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] REQ-01: A config accessor takes a dotted key path and prints the value raw and as JSON, covering the whole configuration surface (type hierarchy, label associations, documentation paths, validation settings).
- [ ] [hard] REQ-02: An unknown key fails nonzero with a typed error listing the valid top-level sections.
- [ ] [hard] REQ-03: Documented in the CLI reference.
title: Config value accessor command
